notes_for_editor: Thin. The only North Baldy-specific source is a one-line Forest Lookouts listing that names the Oregon Department of Forestry and places the point about a mile north of South Baldy. The brief's coordinates (44.6717, -119.9702) sit about 1.0 mile (1.6 km) north of the NHLR South Baldy point (44.656671, -119.971401), which fits that description. Search results also returned Washington's North Baldy (Pend Oreille County: firelookout.com/wa/northbaldy.html and the firetower.org North Baldy Lookout Site), a different tower that is not used. No NHLR or FFLOS entry for an Oregon North Baldy turned up: the firelookout.org Oregon list has South Baldy but no North Baldy. The record's status and kind stay unknown, and the story says nothing about whether a structure stands. The South Baldy paragraph is context about the neighbouring lookout only.
